metadata.description: Bloom aapke sath hai, taki aap apne ghavon se ubhraein, behtar banein aur aagey badein ek behtar future ke liye. Ye aapko Chayn dwara laya gaya hai, jo duniya bhar ke bache logon aur sahyogion dwara chalaya jane wala ek vishv vyaapi gair-laabhkar sanstha hai.

footer.fundedByTitle: Yeh kaam fund kiya gaya hai by

aboutYou.title: Aapke bare mein
aboutYou.description: Yeh sawal humein samjhne mein madad karte hain ki kaun Bloom istemaal kar raha hai aur unhe humse kis tarha ki support chahiye.
aboutYou.descriptionALine1: Abtak aapke uttaron ke liye shukriya!
aboutYou.descriptionALine2: Kyuki aap hamare naye user hain, hum samjhna chahte hain ki hamari sevaon ko istemaal karne se pehle aapn kesa mehsoos kar rahe hain. Hum yeh poochte hain taki hum measure kar sakein ki Bloom ka istemaal karne se survivours par kya asar pad raha hai taki hum sahi cheezo par focus kar paye.

demographicForm.genderLabel: Kripya ek ya ek se adhik option chuniye jis bhi ling se aap pehchaan karte hain.
demographicForm.genderHelpText: Hum yeh aap se pooch rahe hain taki hum behtar samjh sakein ki humare user kis ling se pehchaan karte hain, taki hum zada sahit aur ling-pushti jankaari wale sansadhan bana sakein. Aap “Batana pasand nahi karte” option bhi chun sakte hain.
demographicForm.neurodivergentLabel: Kya aapko koi neuro-manorog hai jo aapke dimaag ke kaam karne ki shamta pe prabhav daalta hai? Yeh koi adhigham shamta ho sakti hai (jaise ki Dyslexia, Dyspraxia, Dyscalculia), ADHD, ya fir Autism.
demographicForm.neurodivergentHelpText: Hum apni sewaon ko sahit banane ki poori koshish karte hain, toh isliye humara yeh jaanna zaroori hai.
demographicForm.raceEthnNatnLabel: Aapki race, ethnicity and nationality kya hai? E.g., White Hispanic Mexican, or Tamil Indian.
demographicForm.raceEthnNatnHelpText: Hum jaante hain ki sab logon ka unki race aur ethnicity ke sath experience alag hota hai jo depend karta hai ki vo kahan rehte hain. Toh aap vo likhiye jo sabse achi tarha se aapko describe karta hai.
demographicForm.countryLabel: Aap kaunse desh mein abhi reh rahe hain?
demographicForm.countryHelpText: Yeh samjhne mein humein madad karega ki survivors services kahan se le rahe hain

baseForm.scaleDescriptionLine1: apni sehmati ke anusaar neeche likhe hue statements ko rate karein:
baseForm.scaleDescriptionLine2: 1 = Poori tarha asehmat, 10 = Poori tarha sehmat

scaleLabels.Q1: Mein samjhti hu ki jo trauma mene experience kiya hai usne kese mere dimaag, shareen aur feelings ko affect kiya hai
scaleLabels.Q2: Mujhe pata hai ki kuch coping mechanisms mujhe long term mein help nahi karte, par yeh bhi pata hai un coping mechanisms ki taraf akarshit hona ek normal trauma response hai
scaleLabels.Q3: Mujhe pata hai ki heal karne ke liye waqt, energy aur sabar chahiye hota hain
scaleLabels.Q4: Mein apne aapko vo poora dhyaan doongi jo mujhe theek hone aur heal hone ke liye chahiye.
scaleLabels.Q5: Mujhe pata hai ki mujhe kya cheezein karna pasand hai aur mein unhe karne ke liye apne routine mein se time nikaalti hu
scaleLabels.Q6: Mein samajhti hu ki trauma se heal hone ka ek hissa hai apne triggers ke saath deal karna
scaleLabels.Q7: Mein samajhti hu ki jo cheezein mujhe surakshit ya asurakshit mehsoos karati hai vo mere liye unique hai
scaleLabels.Q8: Mein pehle he samjh jati hoon jab mere triggering moments, jagahein ya waqt aasakte ho aur unke saath cope karparti hoon.

Courses.title: Humare courses
Courses.introduction: Bloom ke courses humein trauma se nipatne ke liye tailored jankaari, takneekein aur positive shabd dete hain. Vo humein ek surakshit aur empowering space dete hain jahan humein seekhne, pratibimb (reflect) karne aur process karne mein protsahit kiya jata hai.
Courses.noCourses: Abhi dikhane ke liye koi course nahi hai. There are no courses to display right now. Agar yeh sahi nahi lagta, toh dobara prayas karein ya fir Bloom mein team se sampark karien.

chat.title: Humare saath soch vichaar kariye
chat.description: Yadi aap iss sessions par apne vichaar share karna chahte hai toh Bloom team apko sunna pasand karegi!
chat.videoIntro: Sandesh Seva kaise kaam karti hai, iske bare mein aur jaanein:
chat.detailPrivacy: Aapke messages niji aur surakshit hai, vo sirf Bloom team pad sakti hain aur aap gumnaan rehte hain.
chat.detailTimezone: Hum kai alag-alag timezones mein kaam karte hain, isliye aapko humse 6 ghanto ke andar response milna chahiye, aur samay 24 ghanton se adhik nahi hoga.
chat.detailLanguage: Hum humesha Anghrezi aur Spanish mein uplabdh hain, lekin humari team ke sadasya French, Italian, Hindi, Arabic aur Bangla bhi bolte hain. Humein aapke liye unke saath baat karne ki vyvastha karne mein khushi hogi.
chat.detailLegal: Yadi aap ek sakriya kanooni mamle se guzar rahe hain, toh vichaar karein ki aap hamare saath kya share karte hain kyuki yeh kabhi-kabhi aapke mamle ko prabhavit kar sakta hai.
chat.detailImmediateHelp: Yadi aap asann khatre mein hai, toh kripya menu mein "tatkaal sahayata" par jaye taki aapki sahayata ke liye sahi seva mil sake.

Courses.conversationsDescription: Through powerful stories, listen as we challenge myths, spark reflection, and open new ways of understanding harm and healing.
Courses.shortsDescription: Pressed for time or unsure where to start? Shorts are 2–3 minute glimpses into Bloom’s learning sessions that offer insight, reassurance and tools for our healing journey.
Courses.somaticsDescription: Jaanein ki kaise komal, sharir-aadhārit upachaar hinsa, tanav aur darr se upachaar mein madad kar sakte hain. Sansadhanon ka yah sangrah hamare sharir se phir se judne, lachilepan ka nirmaan karne aur suraksha tatha suvidha ka ehsaas kaisa hota hai, yah samajhne mein hamari madad karne ke liye spasht, vyavahārik mārgdarshan pradan karta hai.

steps.step1: Ap hamare dhaayn se chune hue, bahubhashi therapists se chun sakte hain.
steps.step2: Vo din aur samay chuniye jo apke liye sabse acha kaam karta hain. Saare sessions online hain.
steps.step3: Agar aap apka mann badal jata hain, toh kisi bhi samay aap apne sessions rok sakte hain ya therapist badal sakte hain.
steps.step4: Aap jo kuch bhi sajha karte hain vo apke aur therapist ke beech poori tarha gopniye rehta hai.

notes.title: Bloom se Notes ke liye sign up karein
notes.description: Healing ka raasta akela aur kabhi-kabhi kathin ho sakta hai. Hamare Bloom se Notes hafte mein do baar aane wale reminders, encouragement, affirmations, aur hamare courses se activities hain, jo seedhe aapke phone par bheje jaate hain taaki aapki healing journey mein madad mil sake.
notes.createAccountDescription: Bloom se Notes ke liye sign up karein aur hamari resources ki platform tak pahunch prapt karein.
notes.howItWorks: Bloom se Notes kaise kaam karte hain
notes.step1: Hum aapke WhatsApp number par messages bhejte hain
notes.step2: Har hafte do baar, har Budhvaar aur Ravivaar
notes.step3: Hum affirmations, activities aur reflections share karte hain
notes.step4: Agar aap apna mann badlein toh kisi bhi samay unsubscribe kar sakte hain
notes.usNoticeTitle: US subscribers ke liye WhatsApp delivery mein samasya
notes.usNoticeDescription: Meta ne kuch badlaav kiye hain jinse USA mein subscribers ko Notes bhejne mein dikkat aa rahi hai. Hum ise theek karne mein lage hain, lekin abhi messages aap tak nahi pahunch rahe hain. Aap subscribe kar sakte hain — jab sab ke liye theek ho jayega, hum aapko suchit karenge.
notes.subscribeDescription: WhatsApp messages prapt karna shuru karne ke liye Bloom se Notes ke liye subscribe karein. Yahan kabhi bhi unsubscribe karein.
notes.unsubscribeDescription: WhatsApp messages band karne ke liye ya apna number update karne ke liye Bloom se Notes se unsubscribe karein. Kabhi bhi dobara subscribe kar sakte hain.

Messaging.messageHeading: Hamein batayein aapke man mein kya hai

frontChat.welcomeMessage:
Namaste, yahan aap hamaari Bloom team ke bache hue logon aur sahayogiyon se baat kar sakte hain, jinhe ek-doosre ka saath dene ka anubhav hai. Hum yahan hain taki aap apne sawaal, bhavnayen aur vichaar saajha kar sakein, jaise-jaise aap hamare course se guzarte hain.

Yadi aap tatkal nuksan ke khatre mein hain, toh kripya aapatkalin sevaon ko call karein, yadi aap kar sakte hain aur yadi yeh aapke liye surakshit hai. Halankki hum sankat sahayata nahi dete, hum aapko us prakar ki sahayata seva se jodne mein madad kar sakte hain jiski aapko zaroorat hai. Aap hamare vaishvik nirdeshika mein apne kshetra ki sahayata sevaen dekh sakte hain: c.chayn.co/directory.

Aap humse angrezi, French, German, Hindi, Portuguese aur Spanish mein baat kar sakte hain.

Hum hamesha 1-2 dinon ke bheetar aapke sandesh ka jawab dene ka prayas karte hain.
frontChat.empty: Neeche apna pehla sandesh bhejein aur hamaari team jald hi aapse sampark karegi.
frontChat.messageFailed: Bheja nahi ja saka — kripya punah prayas karein.

status.error: Connect nahi ho paya. Kripya baad mein punah prayas karein.

errors.unsupportedImage: Keval JPG, PNG, GIF ya WebP chhaviyan samarthit hain.
errors.fileTooLarge: Failen 25 MB se kam honi chahiye.
errors.uploadFailed: Upload vifal hua. Kripya punah prayas karein.
errors.imageBlocked: Is chhavi ko block kar diya gaya hai kyunki yeh hamare suraksha maandandon par khari nahi utri. Agar aapko lagta hai ki yeh ek galti hai, to kripya humein ek message likhkar iska kaaran batayein.
errors.micPermission: Microphone ki anumati aswikar kar di gayi. Voice note record karne ke liye, apne browser settings mein microphone ki anumati dein aur punah prayas karein.
errors.micUnavailable: Aapke microphone tak pahunch nahi ho saki. Kripya jaanchein ki yeh juda hua hai aur punah prayas karein.
